versions.content: Dedicated physical connections Type: valid Description: The System Constraint Description shall be able to describe that a signal has to be sent over a dedicated wire, which is only used by two SW-Components (sender and receiver). Rationale: This technique is commonly used in current safety concepts. Dependencies: None identified. Use Case: Communication with the airbag module. Supporting Material: –
